desc: a shared script battle (hei_03's four Goombas): the guest's phone app goes to the background at the battle's step 6 for 2.5 s (TTYD_SYNC_BACKGROUND_AT b6:2500: shorter than the rest of the battle, which the host plays on meanwhile at the tests' pace; Android's: its connection kept): it said it stepped away, so the host's player plays its units at once (no 5-second wait for a game that's held), and once it's back in front and caught up its units are its own again; the battle ends in the field in both games (offscreen: the guest's catch-up runs several frames a picture)

log_must: co-op: player 2 stepped away \(their app in the background\)
stepped away: their units are this player's until they're back
is back: their units are theirs again
test: the app to the background at frame [0-9]+ for 2500 ms
net: back from the background after [0-9]+ ms: the connections kept
